title: How to replace an SFP on a transmission node
body: Power down the port, swap module, verify optics. If traffic does not return, open a vendor case.

title: TRN-042 known issue: no traffic after SFP replacement
body: Known issue on TRN-042 only. Workaround: reboot the whole node (we saw it fix it twice).
conflict_note: CONFLICT with Teams/email: reboot is the wrong action; bounce the port. Also the issue is not TRN-042-only.

title: MTU values for core links
